const std = @import("std");

const Header = struct {
    magic: u32,
    version: u16,
    flags: u16,
};

fn readU32(bytes: []const u8) u32 {
    return std.mem.readInt(u32, bytes[0..4], .little);
}

fn readU16(bytes: []const u8) u16 {
    return std.mem.readInt(u16, bytes[0..2], .little);
}

fn checksum(bytes: []const u8) u32 {
    var sum: u32 = 0;
    for (bytes) |b| sum = sum *% 31 +% b;
    return sum;
}

fn alignUp(n: usize, to: usize) usize {
    return (n + to - 1) / to * to;
}

fn sectionCount(h: Header) u16 {
    return h.flags & 0x0fff;
}

fn isCompressed(h: Header) bool {
    return h.flags & 0x8000 != 0;
}

fn payloadOffset(h: Header) usize {
    return alignUp(8 + sectionCount(h) * 4, 16);
}

fn sectionAt(bytes: []const u8, i: u16) !u32 {
    const at = 8 + @as(usize, i) * 4;
    if (at + 4 > bytes.len) return error.Truncated;
    return readU32(bytes[at..]);
}

fn sectionSpan(bytes: []const u8, i: u16) !usize {
    const start = try sectionAt(bytes, i);
    const end = try sectionAt(bytes, i + 1);
    return end - start;
}

fn sectionBounds(bytes: []const u8, i: u16) ![2]u32 {
    const start = try sectionAt(bytes, i);
    const end = try sectionAt(bytes, i + 1);
    if (end < start) return error.BadSection;
    return .{ start, end };
}

fn parseHeader(bytes: []const u8) !Header {
    if (bytes.len < 8) return error.Truncated;
    const magic = readU32(bytes[0..4]);
    if (magic != 0x4c47544d) return error.BadMagic;
    return .{
        .magic = magic,
        .version = readU16(bytes[4..6]),
        .flags = readU16(bytes[6..8]),
    };
}

fn describe(h: Header, out: []u8) ![]u8 {
    return std.fmt.bufPrint(out, "v{d} flags=0x{x}", .{ h.version, h.flags });
}

fn validate(h: Header, len: usize) !void {
    if (payloadOffset(h) > len) return error.Truncated;
    if (h.version == 0) return error.BadVersion;
}

fn readAll(bytes: []const u8) !Header {
    const h = try parseHeader(bytes);
    try validate(h, bytes.len);
    return h;
}

fn summarise(bytes: []const u8) !u32 {
    const h = try readAll(bytes);
    if (isCompressed(h)) return 0;
    return checksum(bytes[payloadOffset(h)..]);
}

fn totalSpan(bytes: []const u8) !usize {
    const h = try readAll(bytes);
    var n: usize = 0;
    var i: u16 = 0;
    while (i + 1 < sectionCount(h)) : (i += 1) n += try sectionSpan(bytes, i);
    return n;
}
